_about: Doncaster for tools/course/real/layout.py. Ring 0 = OSM's outer edge of the turf (point numbers on reference/doncaster/plan-draft.png, lower panel). As at Newbury, OSM's turf (about 50 m wide) includes the jumps course on the inside, so the flat course's inside rail is taken 25 m in from the outer edge round the loop and 28 m in from the stands rail on the straight (the straight course is about 30 m wide). The round course comes off the far bend south of the straight course; its rail runs on diagonally into the run-in on the stands side (shared with the straight mile). The round mile's chute (the spur off the far bend) is narrow: there the inside rail is its own west edge.

stands._about: Owner, 18 Nov 18:00, with old photos of Doncaster (a clock tower beside a long colonnaded stand with its roof terrace packed, 1920s; long low pitched-roof stands down the straight, 1930s; a 1960s cantilever stand with the little hipped-roof pavilion and cupola beside it): 'Use our kit of grandstand parts to create the right vibe'. From the post past the bend to up the course: the ring pavilion (the photo's little pavilion), York's north stand (the modern cantilever stand at the post), York's clock tower, two roof-terrace stands (the colonnaded stand with its packed roof terrace), the Rowley Mile's Victorian stand (the long low stand with the dormer roof), the July Course's old pavilion. [piece, x of its origin (m up the course from the post), set back (m beyond the front line), crowd density] Owner's mark-up, 19:10 (on reference/doncaster/stand-side-plan.png and the Park kit's stand-side elevation): '1' the tiered stand, turned to the bend past the post; '2' four modules in a row, the balcony stand, a roof-terrace stand, the pitched-roof stand and another roof-terrace stand, in place of York's north stand, the clock tower and the two roof-terrace stands; the pavilion he crossed out not used; 'add a clock tower to one of the balcony stands' (York's clock tower's tower, without its base, on the balcony stand's roof). Owner's mark-up, 19:15: the ring pavilion and the old pavilion cut; the tiered stand into the top of the bend (his red box). 19:26 (on a still from the infield): the tiered stand moved in beside the others, trees in the gaps either side of it (perimeter.gapTrees), balloon pods in rows of five along the infield rail (festival balloonRows), more crowd on the rail (festival railCrowd, perimeter.lawnDens) and in the stands (densities 0.85).
